# StabilityAwareScheduling

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A scheduling method that prioritizes grid stability constraints over energy efficiency when allocating computational or power resources. Shifts iNEST design goals from pure performance to stability-critical operation, aligning with grid resilience needs.
